text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon is trying out her
signature
racewear at today's training to
see how it feels
while running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing ramp training. Trainer,
please
provide specific instruc—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

The more I look, the more I can't help
but think
her outfit is straight out of a
sci-fi movie. It suits
her, but I still
wonder what she was thinking with
such
a design.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. I should have asked for your

guidance.
choice_data_list: Did you design the outfit yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You appeared busy at the time,
therefore I
consulted with my father
instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
His exact response was, "Think for
yourself. Your
trainer would probably
say the same."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Once I heard that, I began crafting a
design that I
would consider to be
S-rank.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There are no issues with mobility or
range of
motion. I have determined that
this design will
allow me to maximize my
performance at all
times.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But your question intrigues me. Do you
see a
problem with it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Curious?

Signature racewear is a very important
outfit for a
racer. The emotional
attachment is likely even
stronger when
they've designed their own.

I explain to her that that is why I was
interested in
her reason for the design.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Do you have some time
after
training?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I shall satisfy your curiosity then.
After training, she takes me to...

A planetarium. I suppose this is where
she got her
inspiration from.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Not exactly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To be more precise, an outer space jet
fighter...
perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. One day, when I was young, my
father
turned on the television to check
the weather
forecast.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But instead, a cartoon depicting outer
space
appeared on the screen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There were red trails of light from a star
fighter
cutting through the asteroids.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was awestruck by its immeasurable
energy—its
overwhelming speed and
cutting-edge
technology.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My father didn't change the channel.
Instead, he
spoke to me as I watched.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I recall him saying, "Isn't that neat? Look
at how
fast it's going."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was a power even my father approved

of—something worth aspiring to.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I responded without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run like that," I told him. "As
far as I
can, past the horizon. I want to
run with endless
strength."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
He smiled and said, "I bet that would
feel pretty
good, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My body temperature raised slightly,
which I
identified as a state of
"aspiration."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In short, this racewear reflects the
warmth I felt at
that moment.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I gave it an S-rank myself, but
what would
you give it?
choice_data_list: So that's why you went with that design...
I understand the feeling of admiration!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Do you find it... odd?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should have left the final
decision up to
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer's approval of my personal
signature
racewear... obtained.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

Mihono Bourbon mumbles with slight

embarrassment as we share a
heart-warming
moment together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Do you... really mean it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We are completely different from ships
that fly
through outer space, though...
I think that's exactly why she admires them. Just imagining all the speed and power of a spacecraft packed into a human form is exciting.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Sharing of "feelings" verified.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer. It is indeed very
"awesome."

Mihono Bourbon gives a small, warm
smile as we
continue enjoying the
planetarium.
